name: konecna
description: Konečná. Nevystupovat. Postapokalyptické pixel-artové RPG po Praze v Phaseru 3.

scripts.art: node ${PXL:-$HOME/.claude/skills/pxl-pixel-art/bin/pxl.js} build art/main.px.js --out art/out --no-preview && mkdir -p static/images && cp art/out/atlas.png art/out/atlas.json art/out/landmarks*.png art/out/landmarks*.json art/out/houses_*.png art/out/houses_*.json art/out/ground_*.png art/out/ground_*.json static/images/ && cp art/out/scenes/cs_*.png static/images/ && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('art/version.json', JSON.stringify({ version: Date.now().toString(36) }) + '\n')"
scripts.vysky: test -x .venv/bin/python || (python3.14 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q "laspy[lazrs]" numpy pyproj); .venv/bin/python scripts/vysky.py hlavak --stahnout && .venv/bin/python scripts/vysky.py vaclavak --stahnout && .venv/bin/python scripts/vysky.py staromak --stahnout && .venv/bin/python scripts/vysky.py most --stahnout && .venv/bin/python scripts/vysky.py malastrana --stahnout && .venv/bin/python scripts/vysky.py hrad --stahnout
scripts.strechy: test -x .venv/bin/python || (python3.14 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q "laspy[lazrs]" numpy pyproj pillow); .venv/bin/python scripts/strechy.py hlavak && .venv/bin/python scripts/strechy.py vaclavak && .venv/bin/python scripts/strechy.py staromak && .venv/bin/python scripts/strechy.py most && .venv/bin/python scripts/strechy.py malastrana && .venv/bin/python scripts/strechy.py hrad
scripts.osm: node scripts/osm.mjs hlavak && node scripts/osm.mjs vaclavak && node scripts/osm.mjs staromak && node scripts/osm.mjs most && node scripts/osm.mjs malastrana && node scripts/osm.mjs hrad && npm run art
